alternate_titles: Commentary on the First Letter to the Corinthians
work.author: Thomas Aquinas
work.description: Aquinas's lectura on 1 Corinthians, transmitted in materially different states that must be kept apart. Chapters 1 to 7 verse 10 survive in a text taken from Thomas's own hand; chapters 11 to 13 verse 11 in a reportatio of Reginald of Piperno; chapters 11 to 16 in a separate reportatio vulgata; and chapters 7 to 10 are supplied in printed editions from the abbreviated commentary of Peter of Tarentaise. A claim about chapters 14 to 16, including the much-quoted sentence anima mea non est ego at chapter 15, rests on a reported text and not on wording written by Thomas. A locus is a chapter, optionally with a lectio.
work.title: Super I Epistolam B. Pauli ad Corinthios lectura
